How it works

It starts with your guest experience.

Every hotel is different. Before we design anything, we sit down with your team and understand the stay you already provide, and the one you would ideally like to provide.

No cost to the hotel.Very little work for your team.
Start a conversation →
See the process ↓

Begin with the hotel

First, we get to know your hotel.

We start with a conversation with your management team.

What do guests ask most often? What do you wish they discovered more of? Which parts of the hotel matter most? What would you love every guest to know, notice or experience during their stay?

Then we work out whether a Pocket Hotel Guide makes sense for your property, and what it should actually do.

Your hotel first.
The guide second.

Shape the stay

Then we shape the experience.

We look at what belongs inside the guide, then bring it together around your hotel, your guests and your destination.

Within the hotel

Facilities. Restaurants. Bars. Spa. Offers. Loyalty. The things guests regularly need to know.

Beyond the hotel

Restaurants, experiences and places that could make their stay more memorable.

At the centre

Your property, your guests and the kind of stay you want them to have.

Your judgement matters

You decide what makes the cut.

We research and propose local businesses and experiences that we believe are right for your guests.

Your team reviews the list. Keep the ones you like. Remove the ones you don’t. Add the places you already recommend.

Nothing is included without your approval.

We handle the work

We take it from there.

Once the direction is agreed, your team reviews the important stages and approves the finished guide.

We write the content.

We work with the businesses.

We design around your brand.

We build the live version.

We manage production.

You approve. We manage.

Ready for the guest

Then it becomes part of the stay.

We print and supply the guides for your team to hand to guests.

The physical guide

Something useful to keep with them throughout their stay.

The live version

Somewhere to go for directions, booking links, offers and more information.

No app. No login. No new platform for your team to manage.

After the first box

And we keep looking after it.

The relationship does not end when the first box arrives.

We maintain the live guide, work with the businesses featured within it and help keep the guide useful as things change.

When you need more printed guides, we organise more.

Your team should not have another system to run.

One important detail

All at no cost to your hotel.

Selected local businesses help fund each guide.

They are there because they can add something worthwhile to the guest’s stay, and every business must be approved by your hotel before it is included.

The result should still feel like your hotel guide, not a collection of advertisements.

The first step

Start with a conversation.

Tell us about your hotel, your guests and the experience you are trying to create.

We will work out together whether a Pocket Hotel Guide belongs within it.
